code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Vertical marker columns are the columns containing colored cells in the
    # bottom part of the picture; each marker continues upward through gaps.
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] for r in range(h - 4, h))]
    for c in marker_cols:
        carry = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(h - 1, -1, -1) if grid[r][c]), 0)
        for r in range(h - 1, -1, -1):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v:
                # A horizontal bar crossing the ray sets its color.
                if (c > 0 and c + 1 < w and grid[r][c - 1] == grid[r][c + 1] != 0):
                    carry = grid[r][c - 1]
                elif any(grid[r][x] for x in range(w) if x != c):
                    carry = v
                continue
            if c > 0 and c + 1 < w and grid[r][c - 1] == grid[r][c + 1] != 0:
                carry = grid[r][c - 1]
                out[r][c] = carry
            elif carry:
                out[r][c] = carry
    return out
'''

True def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The bottommost long horizontal bar separates the bars from the vertical
    # marker strokes below it.
    bar_rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v != 0 for v in grid[r]) >= 4]
    last_bar = max(bar_rows)
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] for r in range(last_bar + 1, h))]
    for c in marker_cols:
        carry = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(h - 1, -1, -1) if grid[r][c]), 0)
        for r in range(h - 1, -1, -1):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v:
                # A horizontal bar crossing the ray sets its color.
                if (c > 0 and c + 1 < w and grid[r][c - 1] == grid[r][c + 1] != 0):
                    carry = grid[r][c - 1]
                elif any(grid[r][x] for x in range(w) if x != c):
                    carry = v
                continue
            if c > 0 and c + 1 < w and grid[r][c - 1] == grid[r][c + 1] != 0:
                carry = grid[r][c - 1]
                out[r][c] = carry
            elif carry:
                out[r][c] = carry
    return out
